observations: Organisations, procedures, record identifiers, quantities and outcomes are explicitly fictional.

A demonstrated queue weakness is investigated as a possible cause; a remedial gate depends on the investigation confirming the mechanism.
The later example checks all twelve releases: eleven meet the agreed criteria and one fails. The finding remains open.
Record handling follows approved repository/access arrangements and local criteria. The fictional case provides no real operational assurance.
